about.subtitle: Conozca el programa del 9.º Curso de Verano SAMI, sus objetivos y requisitos de participación.

panel1.title: Acerca de SAMI Summer Course
panel1.text1: SAMI Summer Course es un programa académico internacional celebrado desde 2017 por el Department of Management de IPB University. Sus objetivos: mejorar la competitividad institucional, ampliar redes globales y brindar experiencias de aprendizaje intercultural.
panel1.text2: La 9.ª edición se realiza en formato híbrido del 27 de julio al 15 de agosto de 2026, con sede en el Campus IPB Dramaga, Bogor. Incluye 14 cursos sobre gestión agroalimentaria sostenible.

items.a: SAMI (Sustainable Agrifood Management in Indonesia) is an annual international summer course from Department of Management, IPB University, running since 2017. The 9th edition (2026) is held hybrid 27 July – 15 August, with 14 courses on sustainable agrifood management, essay contest, and field visits in Bogor & Garut.
Two options: Online Course Track (12 live online sessions, 2 credits) and Online + Site Visit Track (12 online sessions + 2 hybrid courses on campus + field visits, 4 credits).

Registration opens 28 April – 17 July 2026, announcement 17 July, and payment deadline 20 July 2026. For fee details, check the program book at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1D1NC92bcacJQB1MCXLwprNpfzdUK8Fk0/view.
Submit application via ipb.link/submission-sami-2026. Read the full program book at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1D1NC92bcacJQB1MCXLwprNpfzdUK8Fk0/view.
12 online sessions run 27–31 July 2026 via Zoom. Slides shared via WhatsApp group one day prior, and also on learning portal samiipb.site.

items.q: What happens during the onsite portion?
items.a: Offline participants arrive in Bogor 9 August, attend 2 hybrid courses (10 & 14 August), and 9 field visits in Bogor & Garut from 10–15 August — including IPB Dramaga Campus, Eptilu agrotourism, Mandalagiri coffee cooperative, Margawati sheep/goat center, Bestory dodol production, Sukaregang leather market, Cangkuang Temple, IPB Science Technopark, and Bogor Botanical Garden.

Yes. Participants who complete the program receive Certificate of Completion, Certificate of Participation for Essay Contest, and credit transcripts (4 credits for full program, 2 credits for online only) issued by Department of Management IPB University.

The essay contest is part of the project assignment. Groups submit essays (max. 3,000 words) plus presentation, with final presentation 14 August at Start Up Science Technopark, Bogor. Top 3 essays get certificates & cash prizes (1st: IDR 3,000,000, 2nd: IDR 2,000,000, 3rd: IDR 1,000,000), and all accepted essays published in SAMI Proceeding with ISBN.

items.q: What is the language of instruction?
items.a: All sessions and essays use English.
